steps.body: You can count in big jumps: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50. Each jump is a whole ten.
steps.narration: You can count in big jumps: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50. Each jump is a whole ten.

widget.prompt: Count by tens: start at 10 and make 2 tens-hops. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That's 3 hops. Make just 2 from 10 to land on 30.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 10 and count on 2: you land on 30.

predict.prompt: One tens-hop from 10 — how far will you land?
predict.reveal: A tens-hop is one BIG jump of ten: 10 lands on 20, skipping all nine numbers between.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents kcc tens to 50.

misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines kcc tens to 50.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

widget.prompt: Count by tens: what comes after 20? Hop one ten and tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That adds just one. Counting by TENS adds a whole ten: 30.
